prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1291; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described in your file. The incident involved a low-speed head-on impact, and our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person, and do not request statements from our client without first obtaining our consent.

We request that you provide, within fifteen days of receipt of this letter, a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy covering the vehicle involved, together with the applicable bodily injury and property damage limits and any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data and telematics, repair and total-loss records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any electronic communications. Please ensure that this material is not altered, repaired, or discarded until we have had the opportunity to inspect it.
